name: streamscope
displayName: Streamscope: HTTP Client with Live Streaming
description: Send requests from .http files and watch streaming responses (NDJSON, SSE, LLM streams) arrive event by event. Capture values from any event and reuse them.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a restricted workspace Streamscope asks once before sending, never reads secrets, .env files, http-client.private.env.json, environments from your user settings, process environment variables or body files, ignores # @insecure, and uses only your own absolute streamscope.request.caFile.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Streamscope sends requests only from local and untitled .http files.

streamscope.request.connectTimeout.patternErrorMessage: Use a duration such as 500ms, 30s or 5m.
streamscope.request.connectTimeout.markdownDescription: How long to wait for the connection, including the TLS handshake, before giving up. A duration such as `500ms`, `30s` or `5m`.

streamscope.request.headersTimeout.patternErrorMessage: Use a duration such as 500ms, 30s or 5m.
streamscope.request.headersTimeout.markdownDescription: How long to wait for the response headers once connected. A duration such as `500ms`, `30s` or `5m`. Use `# @timeout` on a request to limit its total time.

streamscope.request.followRedirects.markdownDescription: Follow redirects. Use `# @no-redirect` to turn this off for one request.

streamscope.request.maxRedirects.markdownDescription: The most redirects to follow for one request.

streamscope.request.caFile.markdownDescription: A PEM file of extra certificate authorities to trust, added to the default and system ones. An absolute path, or a path relative to the workspace folder.

streamscope.stream.maxEventSize.patternErrorMessage: Use a size such as 512KiB, 16MiB or 2GiB.
streamscope.stream.maxEventSize.markdownDescription: The largest single event to read. A larger event becomes an oversize event with a preview and the stream goes on. A size such as `512KiB`, `16MiB` or `2GiB`, from `1KiB` to `256MiB`.

streamscope.stream.memoryEvents.markdownDescription: How many of the newest events of a streaming response stay in memory with their parsed values. Older events are read back from disk when you open them. From 100 to 1000000.

streamscope.stream.maxSpillSize.patternErrorMessage: Use a size such as 512KiB, 16MiB or 2GiB.
streamscope.stream.maxSpillSize.markdownDescription: The most raw data kept on disk for one streaming response. Past it the stream goes on, but its raw data is no longer saved. A size such as `512KiB`, `16MiB` or `2GiB`, at least `1MiB`. A change applies after you reload the window.

streamscope.stream.maxTotalSpillSize.patternErrorMessage: Use a size such as 512KiB, 16MiB or 2GiB.
streamscope.stream.maxTotalSpillSize.markdownDescription: The most raw data kept on disk across all runs in the history. When it is reached, the oldest runs lose their raw data first. A size such as `512KiB`, `16MiB` or `2GiB`, at least `streamscope.stream.maxSpillSize`. A change applies after you reload the window.

streamscope.stream.typeFields.markdownDescription: The JSON fields whose value labels an event, tried in order. At least one, none empty. With `type`, an event `{"type": "RUN_STARTED"}` is labelled `RUN_STARTED`. An SSE event name is used when none of them is present.

streamscope.view.default.markdownDescription: The view a streaming response opens on until you pick another one, which Streamscope then remembers. `reply` is available only when the reply of the stream is recognised.

streamscope.codeLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Show Send Request and the last outcome above each request.
